text: Now turn to section two.
ipa: /nˈaʊ tˈɝn tˈu sˈɛkʃən tˈu/
vi: Bây giờ hãy chuyển sang phần hai.

text: Section two, you will hear a radio program about singing in a choir.
ipa: /sˈɛkʃən tˈu jˈu wˈɪl hˈiɹ ə ɹˈeɪdiˌoʊ pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæm əbˈaʊt sˈɪŋɪŋ ɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/
vi: Phần hai, bạn sẽ nghe một chương trình radio về hát trong dàn hợp xướng.

text: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 15.
ipa: /fˈɝst jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 15/
vi: Đầu tiên, bạn có một chút thời gian để xem các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 15.

text: Now, listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 15.
ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən kˈɛɹfəli ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 15/
vi: Bây giờ, hãy lắng nghe cẩn thận và trả lời các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 15.

text: And for our regular spot on things to do in town, here's our reporter, Samuel Cooper.
ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ spˈɑt ˈɑn θˈɪŋz tˈu dˈu ɪn tˈaʊn hˈɪɹz ˈaʊɚ ɹɪpˈɔɹtɚ sˈæmjul kˈupɚ/
vi: Và với chuyên mục thường lệ về những việc nên làm trong thành phố, đây là phóng viên của chúng tôi, Samuel Cooper.

text: It's been fun to write about joining some of our local choirs. Thank you.
ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn fˈʌn tˈu ɹˈaɪt əbˈaʊt dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ sˈʌm ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ lˈoʊkəl kwˈaɪɹz θˈæŋk jˈu/
vi: Thật vui khi được viết về việc tham gia một số dàn hợp xướng địa phương của chúng tôi. Cảm ơn bạn.

text: Well, feeling a bit apprehensive about my ability to sing in tune,
ipa: /wˈɛl fˈilɪŋ ə bˈɪt ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv əbˈaʊt mˈaɪ əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈɪŋ ɪn tˈun/
vi: Chà, cảm thấy hơi lo lắng về khả năng hát đúng tông của mình,

text: I recently headed off for rehearsals at the town's three biggest choirs Mitchell's Town Choir,
ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli hˈɛdəd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈæt ðə tˈaʊnz θɹˈi bˈɪɡəst kwˈaɪɹz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ/
vi: Tôi gần đây đã đi tập dượt tại ba dàn hợp xướng lớn nhất thị trấn, Dàn hợp xướng Thị trấn Mitchell,

text: the Black Bell Male Voice Choir, and the Caroline Singers.
ipa: /ðə blˈæk bˈɛl mˈeɪl vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ ənd ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/
vi: Hợp xướng nam Black Bell, và Dàn hợp xướng Caroline.

text: I received a very warm welcome at all three choirs.
ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹəsˈivd ə vˈɛɹi wˈɔɹm wˈɛlkəm ˈæt ˈɔl θɹˈi kwˈaɪɹz/
vi: Tôi đã nhận được sự chào đón rất nồng nhiệt tại cả ba dàn hợp xướng.

text: They are always on the lookout for new and enthusiastic singers.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ˈɔlwˌeɪz ˈɑn ðə lˈʊkˌaʊt fˈɔɹ nˈu ənd ɪnθˌuziˈæstɪk sˈɪŋɚz/
vi: Họ luôn tìm kiếm những ca sĩ mới và nhiệt huyết.

text: Now, obviously, deciding which choir to join will depend to some extent
ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɑbviəsli dˌɪsˈaɪdɪŋ wˈɪtʃ kwˈaɪɚ tˈu dʒˈɔɪn wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/
vi: Bây giờ, rõ ràng, việc quyết định tham gia dàn hợp xướng nào sẽ phụ thuộc ở một mức độ nào đó

text: on your taste in music.
ipa: /ˈɑn jˈɔɹ tˈeɪst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/
vi: về sở thích âm nhạc của bạn.

text: Black Bell caters for most musical taste, as it has a hugely varied repertoire,
ipa: /blˈæk bˈɛl kˈeɪtɚz fˈɔɹ mˈoʊst mjˈuzɪkəl tˈeɪst ˈæz ˈɪt hˈæz ə hjˈudʒli vˈɛɹid ɹˈɛpɚtwˌɑɹ/
vi: Black Bell phục vụ hầu hết các sở thích âm nhạc, vì nó có một danh mục nhạc vô cùng đa dạng.

text: as does Mitchell's Town.
ipa: /ˈæz dˈʌz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn/
vi: cũng như Thị trấn của Mitchell.

text: If you're after a more classical feel,
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈæftɚ ə mˈɔɹ klˈæsɪkəl fˈil/
vi: Nếu bạn muốn có cảm giác cổ điển hơn,

text: the Caroline Singers tend to focus on madreals that's unaccompanied singing without any instruments.
ipa: /ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz tˈɛnd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn madreals ðˈæts ˌʌnəkˈʌmpənid sˈɪŋɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛni ˈɪnstɹəmənts/
vi: The Caroline Singers có xu hướng tập trung vào các bản madrigal, đó là hát không có nhạc đệm, không có nhạc cụ nào.

text: If you want to meet people who share an interest in music,
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu mˈit pˈipəl hˈu ʃˈɛɹ ˈæn ˈɪntɹəst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

text: Mitchell's Town Choir is a good place to start.
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd plˈeɪs tˈu stˈɑɹt/

text: Apart from their own performances, they also arrange group visits to see operas
ipa: /əpˈɑɹt fɹˈʌm ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pɚfˈɔɹmənsəz ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɚˈeɪndʒ ɡɹˈup vˈɪzɪts tˈu sˈi ˈɑpɹəz/

text: and attend music festivals, so it can be a great way to make friends.
ipa: /ənd ətˈɛnd mjˈuzɪk fˈɛstəvəlz sˈoʊ ˈɪt kˈæn bˈi ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz/

text: But it's not just a chance to develop a skill, travel,
ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ə tʃˈæns tˈu dɪvˈɛləp ə skˈɪl tɹˈævəl/

text: or make friends that's on offer.
ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz ðˈæts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/

text: You could win a gold medal, too.
ipa: /jˈu kˈʊd wˈɪn ə ɡˈoʊld mˈɛdəl tˈu/

text: Mitchell's Town are hoping to get to the final at the Melody competition in Atlanta,
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ˈɑɹ hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈæt ðə mˈɛlədi kˌɑmpətˈɪʃən ɪn ætlˈæntə/

text: and Blackbell are the current holders of the Countermail Voice Choir Award,
ipa: /ənd blackbell ˈɑɹ ðə kˈɝənt hˈoʊldɚz ˈʌv ðə countermail vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ əwˈɔɹd/

text: which was presented to them by the director of the London Opera just last month.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz pɹizˈɛntɪd tˈu ðˈɛm bˈaɪ ðə dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv ðə lˈʌndən ˈɑpɹə dʒˈʌst lˈæst mˈʌnθ/

text: You can also be a part of a recording deal.
ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ə pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ dˈil/

text: Mitchell's Town has just joined Blackbell and Caroline Singers
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn hˈæz dʒˈʌst dʒˈɔɪnd blackbell ənd kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

text: as recording artists for their first CD due in shops in December.
ipa: /ˈæz ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ ˈɑɹtɪsts fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈɝst sˌidˈi dˈu ɪn ʃˈɑps ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ/

text: And if all of that isn't enough,
ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪzənt ɪnˈʌf/

text: you can also benefit the local community by helping to raise funds for good causes.
ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈɛnəfɪt ðə lˈoʊkəl kəmjˈunəti bˈaɪ hˈɛlpɪŋ tˈu ɹˈeɪz fˈʌndz fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd kˈɑzəz/

text: Mitchell's Town regularly performs its functions, helping the disabled and the elderly,
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ɹˈɛɡjəlɚli pɚfˈɔɹmz ˈɪts fˈʌŋkʃənz hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ðə ˈɛldɚli/

text: while Blackbell donates a percentage of its profits to certain local charities.
ipa: /wˈaɪl blackbell dˈoʊnˌeɪts ə pɚsˈɛntədʒ ˈʌv ˈɪts pɹˈɑfɪts tˈu sˈɝtən lˈoʊkəl tʃˈɛɹətiz/

text: Before you hear the rest of the program,
ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ jˈu hˈiɹ ðə ɹˈɛst ˈʌv ðə pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæm/

text: you have some time to look at questions 16 to 20.
ipa: /jˈu h��æv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 16 tˈu 20/

text: Now listen and answer questions.
ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz/

text: You may feel unable to join a choir
ipa: /jˈu mˈeɪ fˈil ənˈeɪbəl tˈu dʒˈɔɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/

text: because you're worried you'd struggle to find the time to attend rehearsals
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ wˈɝid jˈud stɹˈʌɡəl tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ətˈɛnd ɹɪhˈɝsəlz/

text: because of work or family commitments.
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv wˈɝk ˈɔɹ fˈæməli kəmˈɪtmənts/

text: Well, there is a solution to that start your own choir at work.
ipa: /wˈɛl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə səlˈuʃən tˈu ðˈæt stˈɑɹt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈæt wˈɝk/

text: This has been done in companies large and small,
ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz bˈɪn dˈʌn ɪn kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈɑɹdʒ ənd smˈɔl/

text: and I went to find out about the one at the accountant's John White.
ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɛnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈʌn ˈæt ðə əkˈaʊntənts dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt/

text: The choir's organizer, Elizabeth Arnold, told me the reason she thinks people like the choir.
ipa: /ðə choir's ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɚ ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld tˈoʊld mˈi ðə ɹˈizən ʃˈi θˈɪŋks pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

text: She said that while the thought of a big networking opportunities might be at the back
ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛd ðˈæt wˈaɪl ðə θˈɔt ˈʌv ə bˈɪɡ nˈɛtwˌɝkɪŋ ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz mˈaɪt bˈi ˈæt ðə bˈæk/

text: of some people's mind, it's having the opportunity to switch off
ipa: /ˈʌv sˈʌm pˈipəlz mˈaɪnd ˈɪts hˈævɪŋ ðə ˌɑpɚtˈunəti tˈu swˈɪtʃ ˈɔf/

text: and focus on something completely different that they're after.
ipa: /ənd fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn sˈʌmθɪŋ kəmplˈitli dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈæftɚ/

text: The people that join tend to be fairly competent singers to start
ipa: /ðə pˈipəl ðˈæt dʒˈɔɪn tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɛɹli kˈɑmpətɪnt sˈɪŋɚz tˈu stˈɑɹt/

text: with because, naturally enough, people don't want to look bad in front of their colleagues.
ipa: /wˈɪð bɪkˈɔz nˈætʃɚəli ɪnˈʌf pˈipəl dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk bˈæd ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ kˈɑliɡz/

text: Companies like John White encourage their employees to set up choirs at work
ipa: /kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈaɪk dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ ðˈɛɹ ɛmplˈɔɪiz tˈu sˈɛt ˈʌp kwˈaɪɹz ˈæt wˈɝk/

text: because it can help to create a healthier working atmosphere.
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn hˈɛlp tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ə hˈɛlθiɚ wˈɝkɪŋ ˈætməsfˌɪɹ/

text: For example, people who previously didn't get on can find they have something in common,
ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl pˈipəl hˈu pɹˈiviəsli dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɑn kˈæn fˈaɪnd ðˈeɪ hˈæv sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪn kˈɑmən/

text: which is just common sense really.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kˈɑmən sˈɛns ɹˈɪli/

text: Elizabeth Arnold also stresses
ipa: /ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld ˈɔlsoʊ stɹˈɛsəz/

text: that you don't need a lot of people to get the choir off the ground.
ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈɛt ðə kwˈaɪɚ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

text: They started off four years ago with just five people that's now risen to 19,
ipa: /ðˈeɪ stˈ��ɹtɪd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɪð dʒˈʌst fˈaɪv pˈipəl ðˈæts nˈaʊ ɹˈɪzən tˈu 19/

text: while their average attendance at rehearsals is 12.
ipa: /wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈævɚɪdʒ ətˈɛndəns ˈæt ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈɪz 12/

text: Many people don't have time to go to rehearsals outside work however,
ipa: /mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈaʊtsˈaɪd wˈɝk hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

text: they find the time to go to them while they're at work.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ðˈɛm wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈæt wˈɝk/

text: At John White, they found the middle of the day works best
ipa: /ˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ðˈeɪ fˈaʊnd ðə mˈɪdəl ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ wˈɝks bˈɛst/

text: because not everyone works the same hours, so scheduling early morning rehearsals can be problematic.
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn wˈɝks ðə sˈeɪm ˈaʊɚz sˈoʊ skˈɛdʒʊlɪŋ ˈɝli mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz kˈæn bˈi pɹˌɑbləmˈætɪk/

text: The same is true for late afternoon.
ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪz tɹˈu fˈɔɹ lˈeɪt ˌæftɚnˈun/

text: Supporting their choir is something that John White are very happy to do.
ipa: /səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðˈɛɹ kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈæpi tˈu dˈu/

text: Although members pay a joining fee to cover the cost of refreshments at parties
ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ mˈɛmbɚz pˈeɪ ə dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ fˈi tˈu kˈʌvɚ ðə kˈɑst ˈʌv ɹəfɹˈɛʃmənts ˈæt pˈɑɹtiz/

text: and wear special concert shirts, the company organizes regular sessions with a professional vocal coach,
ipa: /ənd wˈɛɹ spˈɛʃəl kˈɑnsɚt ʃˈɝts ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɪz ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ sˈɛʃənz wˈɪð ə pɹəfˈɛʃənəl vˈoʊkəl kˈoʊtʃ/

text: free of charge, to members of the choir.
ipa: /fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ tˈu mˈɛmbɚz ˈʌv ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

text: So, if you'd like more information about the choirs, that is the end of section two.
ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈaɪɹz ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd ˈʌv sˈɛkʃən tˈu/

text: You now have half a minute,
ipa: /jˈu nˈaʊ hˈæv hˈæf ə mˈɪnət/

text: and for our regular spot on things to do in town, here's our reporter, Samuel Cooper.
ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ spˈɑt ˈɑn θˈɪŋz tˈu dˈu ɪn tˈaʊn hˈɪɹz ˈaʊɚ ɹɪpˈɔɹtɚ sˈæmjul kˈupɚ/

text: It's been fun to write about joining some of our local choirs.
ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn fˈʌn tˈu ɹˈaɪt əbˈaʊt dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ sˈʌm ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ lˈoʊkəl kwˈaɪɹz/

text: Thank you. Well, feeling a bit apprehensive.
ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu wˈɛl fˈilɪŋ ə bˈɪt ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv/

text: About my ability to sing in tune,
ipa: /əbˈaʊt mˈaɪ əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈɪŋ ɪn tˈun/

text: I recently headed off for rehearsals at the town's three biggest choirs Mitchell's Town Choir,
ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli hˈɛdəd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈæt ðə tˈaʊnz θɹˈi bˈɪɡəst kwˈaɪɹz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ/

text: the Black Bell Male Voice Choir, and the Caroline Singers.
ipa: /ðə blˈæk bˈɛl mˈeɪl vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ ənd ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

text: I received a very warm welcome at all three choirs.
ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹəsˈivd ə vˈɛɹi wˈɔɹm wˈɛlkəm ˈæt ˈɔl θɹˈi kwˈaɪɹz/

text: They are always on the lookout for new and enthusiastic singers.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ˈɔlwˌeɪz ˈɑn ðə lˈʊkˌaʊt fˈɔɹ nˈu ənd ɪnθˌuziˈæstɪk sˈɪŋɚz/

text: Now, obviously, deciding which choir to join will depend to some extent
ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɑbviəsli dˌɪsˈaɪdɪŋ wˈɪtʃ kwˈaɪɚ tˈu dʒˈɔɪn wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/

text: on your taste in music.
ipa: /ˈɑn jˈɔɹ tˈeɪst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

text: Black Bell caters for most musical taste, as it has a hugely varied repertoire,
ipa: /blˈæk bˈɛl kˈeɪtɚz fˈɔɹ mˈoʊst mjˈuzɪkəl tˈeɪst ˈæz ˈɪt hˈæz ə hjˈudʒli vˈɛɹid ɹˈɛpɚtwˌɑɹ/

text: as does Mitchell's Town.
ipa: /ˈæz dˈʌz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn/

text: If you're after a more classical feel,
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈæftɚ ə mˈɔɹ klˈæsɪkəl fˈil/

text: the Caroline Singers tend to focus on madreals that's unaccompanied singing without any instruments.
ipa: /ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz tˈɛnd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn madreals ðˈæts ˌʌnəkˈʌmpənid sˈɪŋɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛni ˈɪnstɹəmənts/

text: If you want to meet people who share an interest in music,
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu mˈit pˈipəl hˈu ʃˈɛɹ ˈæn ˈɪntɹəst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

text: Mitchell's Town Choir is a good place to start.
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd plˈeɪs tˈu stˈɑɹt/

text: Apart from their own performances, they also arrange group visits to see operas
ipa: /əpˈɑɹt fɹˈʌm ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pɚfˈɔɹmənsəz ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɚˈeɪndʒ ɡɹˈup vˈɪzɪts tˈu sˈi ˈɑpɹəz/

text: and attend music festivals, so it can be a great way to make friends.
ipa: /ənd ətˈɛnd mjˈuzɪk fˈɛstəvəlz sˈoʊ ˈɪt kˈæn bˈi ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz/

text: But it's not just a chance to develop a skill, travel,
ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ə tʃˈæns tˈu dɪvˈɛləp ə skˈɪl tɹˈævəl/

text: or make friends that's on offer.
ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz ðˈæts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/

text: You could win a gold medal, too.
ipa: /jˈu kˈʊd wˈɪn ə ɡˈoʊld mˈɛdəl tˈu/

text: Mitchell's Town are hoping to get to the final at the Melody Competition in Atlanta,
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ˈɑɹ hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈæt ðə mˈɛlədi kˌɑmpətˈɪʃən ɪn ætlˈæntə/

text: and Blackbell are the current holders of the Countermail Voice Choir Award,
ipa: /ənd blackbell ˈɑɹ ðə kˈɝənt hˈoʊldɚz ˈʌv ðə countermail vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ əwˈɔɹd/

text: which was presented to them by the director of the London Opera just last month.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz pɹizˈɛntɪd tˈu ðˈɛm bˈaɪ ðə dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv ðə lˈʌndən ˈɑpɹə dʒˈʌst lˈæst mˈʌnθ/

text: You can also be a part of a recording deal.
ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ə pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ dˈil/

text: Mitchell's Town has just joined Blackbell and Caroline Singers
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn hˈæz dʒˈʌst dʒˈɔɪnd blackbell ənd kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

text: as recording artists for their first CD due in shops in December.
ipa: /ˈæz ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ ˈɑɹtɪsts fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈɝst sˌidˈi dˈu ɪn ʃˈɑps ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ/

text: And if all of that isn't enough,
ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪzənt ɪnˈʌf/

text: you can also benefit the local community by helping to raise funds for good causes.
ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈɛnəfɪt ðə lˈoʊkəl kəmjˈunəti bˈaɪ hˈɛlpɪŋ tˈu ɹˈeɪz fˈʌndz fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd kˈɑzəz/

text: Mitchell's Town regularly performs its functions, helping the disabled and the elderly,
ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ɹˈɛɡjəlɚli pɚfˈɔɹmz ˈɪts fˈʌŋkʃənz hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ðə ˈɛldɚli/

text: while Blackbell donates a percentage of its profits to certain local charities.
ipa: /wˈaɪl blackbell dˈoʊnˌeɪts ə pɚsˈɛntədʒ ˈʌv ˈɪts pɹˈɑfɪts tˈu sˈɝtən lˈoʊkəl tʃˈɛɹətiz/

text: You may feel unable to join a choir
ipa: /jˈu mˈeɪ fˈil ənˈeɪbəl tˈu dʒˈɔɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/

text: because you're worried you'd struggle to find the time to attend rehearsals
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ wˈɝid jˈud stɹˈʌɡəl tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ətˈɛnd ɹɪhˈɝsəlz/

text: because of work or family commitments.
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv wˈɝk ˈɔɹ fˈæməli kəmˈɪtmənts/

text: Well, there is a solution to that start your own choir at work.
ipa: /wˈɛl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə səlˈuʃən tˈu ðˈæt stˈɑɹt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈæt wˈɝk/

text: This has been done in companies large and small.
ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz bˈɪn dˈʌn ɪn kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈɑɹdʒ ənd smˈɔl/

text: And I went to find out about the one at the accountant's John White.
ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɛnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈʌn ˈæt ðə əkˈaʊntənts dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt/

text: The choir's organizer, Elizabeth Arnold, told me the reason she thinks people like the choir.
ipa: /ðə choir's ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɚ ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld tˈoʊld mˈi ðə ɹˈizən ʃˈi θˈɪŋks pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

text: She said that while the thought of a big networking opportunities might be at the back
ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛd ðˈæt wˈaɪl ðə θˈɔt ˈʌv ə bˈɪɡ nˈɛtwˌɝkɪŋ ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz mˈaɪt bˈi ˈæt ðə bˈæk/

text: of some people's mind...
ipa: /ˈʌv sˈʌm pˈipəlz mˈaɪnd/

text: It's having the opportunity to switch off and focus on something completely different that they're after.
ipa: /ˈɪts hˈævɪŋ ðə ˌɑpɚtˈunəti tˈu swˈɪtʃ ˈɔf ənd fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn sˈʌmθɪŋ kəmplˈitli dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈæftɚ/

text: The people that join tend to be fairly competent singers to start
ipa: /ðə pˈipəl ðˈæt dʒˈɔɪn tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɛɹli kˈɑmpətɪnt sˈɪŋɚz tˈu stˈɑɹt/

text: with, because naturally enough people don't want to look bad in front of their colleagues.
ipa: /wˈɪð bɪkˈɔz nˈætʃɚəli ɪnˈʌf pˈipəl dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk bˈæd ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ kˈɑliɡz/

text: Companies like John White encourage their employees to set up choirs at work,
ipa: /kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈaɪk dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ ðˈɛɹ ɛmplˈɔɪiz tˈu sˈɛt ˈʌp kwˈaɪɹz ˈæt wˈɝk/

text: because it can help to create a healthier working atmosphere.
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn hˈɛlp tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ə hˈɛlθiɚ wˈɝkɪŋ ˈætməsfˌɪɹ/

text: For example, people who previously didn't get on can find they have something in common,
ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl pˈipəl hˈu pɹˈiviəsli dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɑn kˈæn fˈaɪnd ðˈeɪ hˈæv sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪn kˈɑmən/

text: which is just common sense, really.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kˈɑmən sˈɛns ɹˈɪli/

text: Elizabeth Arnold also stresses
ipa: /ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld ˈɔlsoʊ stɹˈɛsəz/

text: that you don't need a lot of people to get the choir off the ground.
ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈɛt ðə kwˈaɪɚ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

text: They started off four years ago with just five people.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ stˈɑɹtɪd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɪð dʒˈʌst fˈaɪv pˈipəl/

text: That's now risen to 19, while their average attendance at rehearsals is 12.
ipa: /ðˈæts nˈaʊ ɹˈɪzən tˈu 19 wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈævɚɪdʒ ətˈɛndəns ˈæt ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈɪz 12/

text: Many people don't have time to go to rehearsals outside work however,
ipa: /mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈaʊtsˈaɪd wˈɝk hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

text: they find the time to go to them while they're at work.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ðˈɛm wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈæt wˈɝk/

text: At John White, they found the middle of the day works best
ipa: /ˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ðˈeɪ fˈaʊnd ðə mˈɪdəl ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ wˈɝks bˈɛst/

text: because not everyone works the same hours, so scheduling early morning rehearsals can be problematic.
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn wˈɝks ðə sˈeɪm ˈaʊɚz sˈoʊ skˈɛdʒʊlɪŋ ˈɝli mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz kˈæn bˈi pɹˌɑbləmˈætɪk/

text: The same is true for late afternoon.
ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪz tɹˈu fˈɔɹ lˈeɪt ˌæftɚnˈun/

text: Supporting their choir is something that John White are very happy to do.
ipa: /səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðˈɛɹ kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈæpi tˈu dˈu/

text: Although members pay a joining fee to cover the cost of refreshments at parties
ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ mˈɛmbɚz pˈeɪ ə dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ fˈi tˈu kˈʌvɚ ðə kˈɑst ˈʌv ɹəfɹˈɛʃmənts ˈæt pˈɑɹtiz/

text: and wear special concert shirts, the company organizes regular sessions with a professional vocal coach,
ipa: /ənd wˈɛɹ spˈɛʃəl kˈɑnsɚt ʃˈɝts ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɪz ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ sˈɛʃənz wˈɪð ə pɹəfˈɛʃənəl vˈoʊkəl kˈoʊtʃ/

text: free of charge to members of the choir.
ipa: /fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ tˈu mˈɛmbɚz ˈʌv ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

text: So, if you'd like more information about the choirs, that is the end.
ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈaɪɹz ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd/
